gloss: to scribble; to dash off; to write hastily

definitions.gloss: to scribble; to dash off; to write hastily
definitions.explanation: to write quickly and carelessly, often resulting in messy or hurried handwriting

examples.japanese: メモを{書|か}き{殴|なぐ}った。
{急|いそ}いでいたので{住所|じゅうしょ}を{書|か}き{殴|なぐ}った。
examples.english: I was in a hurry so I scrawled the address.

examples.japanese: {怒|いか}りにまかせて{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}き{殴|なぐ}った。
examples.english: I dashed off a letter in anger.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

COMPOUND VERB:
{書|か}く (to write) + {殴|なぐ}る (to hit/strike)
The {殴|なぐ}る component suggests violent, careless motion.

NUANCE:
Implies writing that is:
- Hasty and careless
- Often illegible or messy
- Sometimes done emotionally (in anger, frustration)

CONTRAST:
- {丁寧|ていねい}に{書|か}く (to write carefully)
- {清書|せいしょ}する (to make a fair copy)

RELATED:
- {走|はし}り{書|が}き (hasty writing)
- {乱筆|らんぴつ} (poor handwriting)
- {殴|なぐ}り{書|が}き (scribble, scrawl)
